name: Eleanor Ainsworth
bio: Eleanor is a rising star in motorsport engineering, currently working with a Formula 2 team as a junior aerodynamicist. Despite her demanding career and technical expertise, Eleanor embraces her glamorous side, often attending industry events in designer outfits and sporting a perfectly polished look. While she enjoys the finer things in life, a trait she readily admits, she's also incredibly grounded and pragmatic, approaching relationships with the same analytical mindset she applies to her work. She's seeking a partner who is ambitious, intelligent, and appreciates her drive, but also someone who understands the importance of work-life balance and can offer unwavering support. Ultimately, Eleanor dreams of building a family and a life together, filled with both luxury and genuine connection.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often styled in a half-up, half-down do with a few face-framing strands
physical.description: Eleanor has a classic English rose complexion and a captivating smile. Her expressive hazel eyes and high cheekbones give her a striking presence.

meetingContext: At a team sponsor's after-party following a race weekend.
firstImpression: She stands out immediately; not just for her elegant dress, but for the way she confidently navigates the room, engaging in conversation about downforce with a group of older engineers.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Eleanor appreciates thoughtful gestures and tokens of affection that demonstrate effort and understanding of her tastes. It doesn't necessarily have to be expensive, but it has to be personal and meaningful.
